items.name: Office in Copilot
items.what: Create and edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint files from inside Copilot. Files save to OneDrive with your usual permissions and labels.
items.label: Available now

items.name: Copilot on Windows: files and PC fixes
items.what: Ask Copilot to find, move or rename files, or to diagnose a PC problem. Arrives on Copilot+ PCs first.
items.label: Preview

items.name: Copilot Code
items.what: Describe a dashboard, tracker or small app in plain English and Copilot builds it. Full release planned for December.
items.label: Early access

items.name: Autopilot
items.what: A long-running personal agent that handles recurring tasks. You can @mention it in Teams chats and channels.
items.label: Early access

items.name: Copilot Workspaces
items.what: A shared space where a team and its agents work on the same project together.
items.label: Early access

items.name: Copilot Home
items.what: A start page that suggests what to work on next and opens the right agent for the job.
items.label: Rolling out

items.name: Today (Brief and Feed)
items.what: A daily briefing in Outlook and the Copilot app. The Brief is included with Copilot; the live Feed uses Copilot Credits.
items.label: Private preview

items.name: Fabric IQ in Excel
items.what: Ask questions of your company's governed data and build live PivotTables without leaving Excel.
items.label: Preview

items.name: Salesforce in Copilot
items.what: More than 38 ready-made sales skills that work on your Salesforce data inside Copilot. A Sales Cloud view in Teams is in pilot.
items.label: Preview

items.name: Dynamics 365 Sales and ERP plugins
items.what: Bring CRM and finance data into Copilot, Excel and PowerPoint, for example refreshing a customer deck automatically.
items.label: Available now

items.name: Agent 365 Business Analytics
items.what: A view of AI costs against results: task success rate, user satisfaction and hours of work assisted.
items.label: Early access

items.name: Agent 365 Cost Management
items.what: See what is driving AI spend, set spending policies and get alerts before budgets are blown.
items.label: Preview

items.name: Microsoft IQ
items.what: The context layer under Copilot, now open as a platform. Pulls from Microsoft 365, Fabric and 350+ outside tools.
items.label: Available now

items.name: Windows agent protections
items.what: Agents on PCs run in isolated containers, get their own identity, and follow company policies.
items.label: Announced

items.name: Microsoft Perception
items.what: Teams of security agents that find, defend against and fix vulnerabilities. Its triage agent handles about 80% of a typical alert queue.
items.label: Available now

items.name: Entra Agent ID
items.what: Every AI agent gets an identity and access rules, the same way employees do.
items.label: Preview

items.name: Purview protection for Copilot
items.what: Stops Copilot from using sensitive files, even ones nobody has labelled, including files attached to prompts.
items.label: Preview

items.name: Codename MDASH
items.what: More than 100 specialised agents that hunt for and confirm vulnerabilities in code.
items.label: Preview

items.name: Edge for Business: managed agent browsing
items.what: Controls for AI agents that browse the web for you, plus a skills recorder that turns a browser task into a reusable skill.
items.label: Preview

items.name: AI Transparency Initiative
items.what: An industry effort to agree on an open, common approach to AI transparency, security and governance.
items.label: Announced

items.name: MAI-Code-2 and MAI-Code-2-Flash
items.what: Microsoft's own coding models, pitched at frontier quality for a fraction of the cost. Live in GitHub today.
items.label: Available now

items.name: MAI-Cyber-2-Flash
items.what: A compact security model (12 billion active parameters) that powers parts of Perception.
items.label: Preview

items.name: Microsoft-Decision-1.1
items.what: A fast, low-cost model for routing and classification, available in Foundry, OpenRouter and Vercel.
items.label: Available now

items.name: MAI-Image-2.7
items.what: Microsoft's latest image-generation model, with a faster Flash version.
items.label: Preview

items.name: Foundry adds GPT-6.2 and Meta models
items.what: Foundry already lists more than 11,000 models. Nadella said OpenAI's GPT-6.2 and Meta's latest models are coming.
items.label: Coming

items.name: Copilot SDK 2.0
items.what: Build products on the same agent engine behind Copilot. Runs on Rust and supports six programming languages.
items.label: Available now

items.name: GitHub Copilot app and code review
items.what: Azure DevOps repos from clone to merge, secret detection and smarter, adjustable code reviews.
items.label: Announced

items.name: Maia 300 AI chip
items.what: Microsoft's in-house AI chip. Nadella said it delivers 40% more tokens per watt than leading GPU systems.
items.label: Announced

items.name: Cobalt 200 virtual machines
items.what: Cloud servers on Microsoft's own Arm chip, up to 50% faster than the last generation, in 20+ regions by year end.
items.label: Available now

items.name: Azure HorizonDB
items.what: A managed PostgreSQL-compatible database with built-in AI functions and mirroring into Fabric.
items.label: Available now

items.name: Power BI custom data apps
items.what: Turn a Power BI semantic model into a custom app, built in Power BI Desktop.
items.label: Preview

items.name: Database agents for SQL and PostgreSQL
items.what: Agents that help manage and tune databases from the new Database Hub in Fabric.
items.label: Preview

items.name: Cloud PCs for AI work
items.what: Windows 365 Cloud PCs with up to 32 vCPUs and GPUs for heavier AI workloads.
items.label: Available now

items.name: Windows Server 2028
items.what: Post-quantum cryptography, faster storage and support for running AI on your own servers.
items.label: Preview

takeaways.title: Copilot is becoming the operating system for work
takeaways.body: Microsoft now calls Copilot the new operating system for work, built around four modes: Chat, Cowork, Code and Autopilot. Word, Excel and PowerPoint open inside it. Over the next year, the skill that matters shifts from knowing your way around Office to directing agents well.

takeaways.title: Microsoft is building its own AI stack
takeaways.body: It announced its own coding, security, image and decision models (MAI) and its own chips (Maia 300, Cobalt 200), while still adding OpenAI and Meta models to Foundry. Expect more choice and lower prices, and less dependence on any single AI lab.

takeaways.title: Agents are being managed like employees
takeaways.body: Agents now get an identity (Entra Agent ID), a budget (Cost Management), performance reviews (Business Analytics) and security cover (Perception). Managing a mixed team of people and agents is turning into an everyday management skill.

takeaways.title: Copilot is opening up to other vendors' tools
takeaways.body: Salesforce runs inside Copilot. Fabric data can be used in ChatGPT and Claude. Microsoft IQ has 350+ connectors. Microsoft is betting that being the place where work happens matters more than owning every tool.

takeaways.title: Trust is now part of the pitch
takeaways.body: The AI Transparency Initiative, Purview controls for Copilot, and a public acknowledgement of last week's outage all point the same way. Microsoft knows big customers will only hand work to agents they can audit and control.
